# Grandma Irving

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Personality

Grandma Irving holds a distinct anti-American bias. She expresses relief when family members marry non-[Americans](../codex/factions.md#americans), believing that a successful marriage to an American is an anomaly that is unlikely to occur twice.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002)_

## History

Grandma Irving was known throughout [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for raising her grandson using traditional methods of diet and morals.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012)_
